'''''Lamium coutinhoi''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the mint family [[Lamiaceae]], [[endemic]] to central and northern [[Portugal]]. It inhabits path margins, roadsides and damp slopes, pastures and edges of cultivated fields, in granitic substrates.<ref name="flora-on" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Lamium coutinhoi J.G.García |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/3S29P |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=6 April 2021}}</ref>
